---
title: "Map"
---

This is a working map of sites in County Dublin linked to the Catholic Church: churches, convents, presbyteries and religious houses, Catholic-ethos schools, institutions run by religious orders, and nursing homes and disability centres whose registered provider is an order or Church body. It is built from open data, including OpenStreetMap, the National Inventory of Architectural Heritage, the four Dublin councils' Records of Protected Structures, the Department of Education school lists, HIQA's register of care centres and the official reports on residential institutions. For the full method and every source, see [Method](method.qmd).

Each point shows where a site is, not who owns it. Ownership is confirmed site by site against Land Registry folios, so for now every point is a lead (grade D on the [evidence scale](method.qmd#confidence-grades)), apart from properties the State records as handed over by the orders, which are former holdings (grade E).

## The landscape of Ireland's charities

Every registered charity in Ireland, grouped by the charitable purposes it registered under, from the Charities Regulator's register (26 October 2026). Charities for the advancement of religion are in orange. Schools with a Catholic ethos in the Department of Education lists are in blue, and community schools with a Catholic bishop or order as joint patron are in light blue. Schools register for education, not religion, so they sit inside the Education cluster. Hover or tap a dot to read the charity's objects.

<iframe id="charities-landscape" src="maps/charities_landscape.html" width="100%" height="1400" style="border:0;display:block" title="Registered charities in Ireland by charitable purpose" loading="lazy"></iframe>

<script>
(() => {
  const f = document.getElementById('charities-landscape');
  const fit = () => { try { f.style.height = Math.ceil(f.contentDocument.body.getBoundingClientRect().height) + 'px'; } catch (e) {} };
  f.addEventListener('load', () => {
    fit();
    try { new ResizeObserver(fit).observe(f.contentDocument.body); } catch (e) {}
  });
})();
</script>
